title: Health Resort management office safe key

infobox.usage: Unlocks a Safe in one of the offices in the Administration Building on Shoreline

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort management office safe key (Safe) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium warehouse office safe, located in the Administration building.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs
